facts.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch

setpoint.label: fire watch duration after completion of hot work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.body: The provision and briefing of a competent fire watch shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a critical control. The fire watch duration after completion of hot work shall be set at 30 min. This clause applies to activities archived under CONTROL-OF-IGNITION-SOURCES at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
